SELECT 
    COUNT(CASE WHEN l."GOT" >= 60 THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*)
FROM main."Laboratory" l
WHERE l."Date" BETWEEN DATE '1997-01-01' AND DATE '1997-12-31'
    AND l."Date" <= DATE '1998-06-01';
